description: Validation set for tuning retrieval knobs (router section boost, rerank pool). Disjoint from gold_questions.json, which stays the held-out test set: tune here, report there. Same format and matching rule as gold_questions.json. Gold strings were checked against the parsed section chunks of the local uploads on 2026-10-23.
